transcript.t: This term, I have three goals. My first goal is to get up at six thirty every day.
My second goal is to read for twenty minutes before bed. I want to finish six books by the end of the term.
My third goal is to learn to draw. I will take one painting class every Sunday.
These goals are not too big, so I think I can stick to them.
If I feel tired, I will remind myself why I started.
At the end of the term, I will check my list and reward myself with a new notebook.
